text: Handling deadlines well starts with good time management. When you receive a task, break it into smaller steps and plan when to do each one. Prioritization is also important: decide which tasks are most urgent and focus on them first. If you realise you cannot finish everything, use scope management—agree with your manager on what is essential and what can wait. Finally, communication is key. Tell your team early if you are falling behind, instead of waiting until the last minute. With these simple habits, you can stay calm, meet your deadlines, and keep everyone informed.
